text: Compiled from (sacred) books and from sages, exalted saints, whose souls are in Eden; based on the verse “For it is exceedingly near to you, in your mouth and in your heart, to do”; to explain clearly how it is exceedingly near, in a lengthy and short way, with the aid of the Holy One, blessed be He.
